text:
Gold Price in 2018
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2018, the LBMA gold price fell 4.9% between 2018-01-31 ($1,345) and 2018-12-28 ($1,279). The highest sampled price was $1,345 in January and the lowest was $1,187 in September. The mean of these observations was $1,265. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
